summary: Market tone is mixed-to-risk-on in crypto, with only limited fresh analyst coverage surfaced today and a notable bullish bias on ETH, NEAR, and ZEC from Michaël van de Poppe-related commentary. Macro sentiment is softer for crude and broadly supportive for gold, while major equity indexes remain uneven and the dollar is firmer on the week.

signals.name: Bitcoin
signals.reason: Across the titles, he repeatedly frames Bitcoin as weak or at risk of a flush, with only a few short-term long setups around CPI/FOMC and rejection points, so the clearest directional bias is bearish-to-cautious with tactical bounce trades.
signals.chart_pattern: resistance rejection, flush risk, swing-low reclaim
